# ttvnw.net
> Twitch’s web platform domain for live streaming, developer resources, support, safety, and related product documentation.

This domain and its associated Twitch properties provide access to livestreaming products, creator and viewer help resources, developer documentation, API references, safety policies, and newsroom updates.

## Core Platform
- [Twitch](https://www.twitch.tv): Main live streaming platform for watching channels, clips, and live broadcasts.
- [Browse](https://www.twitch.tv/directory): Directory for discovering live channels by category, game, and interest.
- [Esports](https://www.twitch.tv/directory/esports): Dedicated directory area for esports streams and competitive events.
- [Music](https://www.twitch.tv/directory/music): Category hub for music livestreams, performances, and creator sessions.
- [Turbo](https://www.twitch.tv/turbo): Subscription product offering ad-free viewing and enhanced chat features.
- [Prime Gaming](https://gaming.amazon.com): Amazon’s gaming benefits hub closely integrated with Twitch accounts and rewards.

## Creators
- [Creator Camp](https://www.twitch.tv/creatorcamp): Educational hub for streamers learning setup, growth, and community practices.
- [Creator Dashboard](https://dashboard.twitch.tv): Central dashboard for managing streams, moderation, analytics, and channel settings.
- [Stream Manager](https://dashboard.twitch.tv/u/login/stream-manager): Live control panel for running broadcasts and monitoring stream health.
- [Analytics](https://dashboard.twitch.tv/u/login/channel-analytics): Channel analytics for audience, engagement, and stream performance metrics.
- [Video Producer](https://dashboard.twitch.tv/u/login/content/video-producer): Management area for VODs, highlights, uploads, and clips.
- [Drops Campaigns](https://dashboard.twitch.tv/u/login/viewer-rewards/drops): Creator interface for configuring and tracking Drops participation.

## Developers
- [Twitch Developers](https://dev.twitch.tv): Main developer portal for APIs, extensions, EventSub, and integration guides.
- [Docs Home](https://dev.twitch.tv/docs): Entry point for Twitch developer documentation and platform concepts.
- [API Reference](https://dev.twitch.tv/docs/api/reference): Reference documentation for Twitch Helix API endpoints and parameters.
- [Authentication](https://dev.twitch.tv/docs/authentication): OAuth flows, token handling, scopes, and authentication requirements.
- [EventSub](https://dev.twitch.tv/docs/eventsub): Event subscription system for receiving Twitch platform notifications.
- [Extensions](https://dev.twitch.tv/docs/extensions): Documentation for building interactive Twitch Extensions experiences.
- [Embedded Experiences](https://dev.twitch.tv/docs/embed): Guides for embedding Twitch video, chat, and clips on websites.
- [CLI](https://dev.twitch.tv/docs/cli): Twitch CLI tooling for local development, testing, and EventSub workflows.

## API and SDK Resources
- [Chat and Chatbots](https://dev.twitch.tv/docs/chat): Documentation for IRC, chatbots, and chat-related integrations.
- [PubSub](https://dev.twitch.tv/docs/pubsub): Legacy PubSub system documentation for receiving selected Twitch events.
- [Drops](https://dev.twitch.tv/docs/drops): Developer documentation for implementing Twitch Drops campaigns and rewards.
- [Game Engine Plugins](https://dev.twitch.tv/docs/game-engine-plugins): Resources for integrating Twitch features into supported game engines.
- [Extensions Reference](https://dev.twitch.tv/docs/extensions/reference): Technical reference for extension helpers, APIs, and capabilities.
- [EventSub Reference](https://dev.twitch.tv/docs/eventsub/eventsub-reference): Detailed EventSub subscription types and payload definitions.

## Help and Support
- [Help Center](https://help.twitch.tv): Main support portal for viewers, creators, and account troubleshooting.
- [Viewer Help](https://help.twitch.tv/s/article/viewer-basics): Introductory help content for watching streams and using Twitch features.
- [Affiliate Program Help](https://help.twitch.tv/s/article/joining-the-affiliate-program): Support article covering Twitch Affiliate eligibility and onboarding.
- [Partner Program Help](https://help.twitch.tv/s/article/partner-program-overview): Overview of Twitch Partner requirements, benefits, and application details.
- [Two-Factor Authentication](https://help.twitch.tv/s/article/two-factor-authentication): Instructions for enabling and managing account security with 2FA.
- [Chat Commands](https://help.twitch.tv/s/article/chat-commands): Reference for common Twitch chat commands and moderation shortcuts.
- [Contact Support](https://help.twitch.tv/s/contactsupport): Support contact flow for account, billing, and technical issues.

## Safety and Policies
- [Safety Center](https://safety.twitch.tv): Central hub for Twitch safety tools, policies, and enforcement information.
- [Community Guidelines](https://safety.twitch.tv/s/article/Community-Guidelines): Rules governing behavior, content, and platform conduct on Twitch.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.twitch.tv/p/en/legal/terms-of-service): Legal terms governing use of Twitch services and accounts.
- [Privacy Notice](https://www.twitch.tv/p/en/legal/privacy-notice): Privacy policy describing data collection, use, and user rights.
- [DMCA Guidelines](https://www.twitch.tv/p/en/legal/dmca-guidelines): Copyright complaint and counter-notification procedures for Twitch content.
- [Law Enforcement Guidelines](https://safety.twitch.tv/s/article/Law-Enforcement-Guidelines): Information for legal requests and emergency disclosure processes.
- [Transparency Reports](https://safety.twitch.tv/s/article/Transparency-Reports): Reports summarizing enforcement actions and safety-related platform metrics.

## Business and Advertising
- [Twitch Advertising](https://advertising.twitch.tv): Information for brands and agencies advertising on Twitch.
- [Brand Partnership Studio](https://brandpartnershipstudio.twitch.tv): Partnership and campaign opportunities for brands working with Twitch creators.
- [Bounty Board](https://help.twitch.tv/s/article/bounty-board-program-information): Program information for sponsored creator campaigns on Twitch.
- [Monetization](https://www.twitch.tv/p/en/partners/): Overview of creator monetization pathways including Affiliate and Partner programs.

## News and Updates
- [Twitch Blog](https://blog.twitch.tv): Official blog with product announcements, creator news, and platform updates.
- [Newsroom](https://blog.twitch.tv/en/newsroom): Corporate newsroom for press releases and company announcements.
- [Product News](https://blog.twitch.tv/en/tags/product): Tagged updates covering Twitch product launches and feature changes.
- [Developers Blog](https://blog.twitch.tv/en/tags/developers): Posts relevant to API changes, developer tools, and platform integrations.
- [Creators Blog](https://blog.twitch.tv/en/tags/creators): Articles focused on streamer programs, features, and creator initiatives.

## Company
- [About Twitch](https://www.twitch.tv/p/en/about): Overview of Twitch’s mission, community, and platform identity.
- [Careers](https://www.twitch.tv/jobs): Job listings and information about working at Twitch.
- [Press Center](https://blog.twitch.tv/en/newsroom): Official source for media resources and company announcements.
- [Accessibility](https://help.twitch.tv/s/article/accessibility): Accessibility-related support information for using Twitch products.
- [Legal](https://www.twitch.tv/p/en/legal): Index of Twitch legal policies, notices, and governing documents.
